# CybeDefend

> The open source Snyk & Aikido alternative. Agentic AppSec: every scanner in one place, one self-hosted dashboard with security policies, and one command for any coding agent, /cybedefend, that scans, fixes what blocks and says if the code can ship.

- [README](README.md): what it does, the command, integrations
- [Skill](skills/cybedefend/SKILL.md): what your agent runs
- [Agents](AGENTS.md): quick reference for coding agents
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability in CybeDefend
